depth.foreground: nothing or a soft blurred edge
depth.background: a simple blurred place that fits the mood

questions.camera.angle: From what angle should we see it (low looks powerful, high looks small, eye level is neutral)?
questions.light.direction: Where should the main light come from (behind gives a silhouette edge, the side gives drama, front is flat and clear)?
questions.actors.*.action_state: Which feeling should the face and body show (grieving, proud, afraid, guilty, peaceful ...)?

staging_rules: The face and posture carry the feeling; the background stays simple.
Close or medium distance so the expression is readable.
